records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales decreased by $1.0 million, or (0.8)%, during the three months ended March 31, 2023, compared to the three months ended March 31, 2022, primarily due to reduced volume and unfavorable foreign exchange effects of $1.4 million, partially offset by higher customer pricing and premium pricing on a certain customer project.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Selling, general, and administrative expense decreased by $0.3 million during the three months ended March 31, 2023, compared to the three months ended March 31, 2022, primarily due to lower stock compensation expense partially offset by higher professional fees.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Other operating expense, net decreased by $1.0 million during the three months ended March 31, 2023, compared to the three months ended March 31, 2022, primarily due to a legal settlement reached during the first quarter of 2022, partially offset by losses on sales of machinery and equipment during the first quarter of 2023.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Cost of sales increased by $3.8 million, or 3.7%, during the three months ended March 31, 2023, compared to the three months ended March 31, 2022, primarily due to higher material and labor costs due to inefficient manufacturing processes associated with product launches, partially offset by lower sales volume and favorable foreign exchange effects.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Income from operations increased by $1.4 million during the three months ended March 31, 2023 compared to the same period in the prior year, primarily due to premium pricing on a certain customer project in the first quarter of 2023 and a legal settlement reached during the first quarter of 2022.
